newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA FEBRUARY MONTHLY INFLATION 242.7 PCT.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA FEBRUARY MONTHLY INFLATION 242.7 PCT.

text.p: Bulgaria's monthly inflation in February rose to 242.7 pct from 43.5 pct in January, an official of the National Statistics Institue said on Monday.
"The very large inflation figure resulted from the sharp
lev devaluation at the beginning of February which boosted
prices of imported raw materials and goods and also a
speculative increase in retailers' prices," the official said.
He said the inflation figure was the highest monthly rate
recorded in Bulgaria. The previous high was 121 percent reached
in February 1991, when Bulgaria first liberalised prices.
The lev fell to 3,000 to the dollar from 2,000 to the
dollar in the first week of the month before rebounding. Bread
prices rose by 144 percent during the month, mainly due to the
grain shortage.
